ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for register updates (rdata, rden). It sequences the mem_access and bus_feedback processes that update internal registers.
ports.evidence: process(clk_i) and elsif rising_edge(clk_i) in mem_access and bus_feedback processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides an asynchronous reset that forces rden to '0' when low. It overrides the clocked assignment to rden in the bus_feedback process.
ports.evidence: process(rstn_i, clk_i) and if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' in bus_feedback

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Aggregates the request fields (addr, data, stb, rw, etc.) supplied by the bus master; its fields drive internal logic and registers (addr selects ROM, stb/rw determine rden).
role: input bundle (provides address and control fields)
ports.evidence: port declaration and uses of its fields in mem_access and bus_feedback (bus_req_i.addr, bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw)

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies the word address bits used (slice) to index mem_rom_c; the selected ROM word is captured into rdata on clock edges to form read data.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request bundle but not read or used anywhere in this source; it carries no effect on internal signals here.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request bundle but not referenced in this source; it does not affect ROM access or responses here.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.function: strobe that requests a bus access
ports.functionality: Participates in the clocked assignment that produces rden by combining with rw; when high (and rw='0') it causes the next-cycle rden to be set, enabling data/ack output.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in the rising_edge branch of bus_feedback

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Used (negated) together with stb to form the rden enable; a '0' here (with stb) selects a read and allows rden to be asserted next cycle.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in the rising_edge branch of bus_feedback

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared in the request bundle but not referenced in this source; it does not participate in ROM access or response logic here.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this source; it carries no effect on internal logic here.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug

ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo

ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; no references elsewhere in this source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Aggregates response fields (data, ack, err) driven from internal signals (rdata, rden) and constants; it exports the ROM response to the bus master.
ports.evidence: Assignments to bus_rsp_o.data, bus_rsp_o.ack, bus_rsp_o.err in the architecture

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Combinationally driven from rden and exported to the bus master; it reports when a read response is available (rden asserted).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Driven to constant '0' and exported; it does not reflect internal state or change with inputs in this source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Combinationally driven from rdata when rden is '1', otherwise zeros; it exports the ROM word captured in rdata to the bus master.

signals.name: rden
signals.functionality: Clocked register that captures the read-enable expression (bus_req_i.stb and not bus_req_i.rw) on rising edges; reset asynchronously to '0' by rstn_i. It enables ack and data output when asserted.
signals.evidence: bus_feedback process: if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw); and bus_rsp_o assignments

signals.name: rdata
signals.functionality: Clocked register loaded from mem_rom_c indexed by bus_req_i.addr slice on each rising clock; it supplies the response data bus_rsp_o.data when rden enables output.
signals.evidence: mem_access process: on rising_edge(clk_i) rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(...)))); and bus_rsp_o.data uses rdata
